CustomField.description: Whether a HubSpot record with a BLANK Salesforce-id property may create a new Salesforce record. Default false (update-only). A HubSpot record whose sf-id property IS populated but whose Salesforce record no longer exists is never created regardless of this flag -- that is a deleted record, and recreating it would break delete-termination.
CustomField.label: Inbound Create Unmatched
